goal: Add PolicyBatchEvaluator, a frozen sequential batch orchestrator whose constructor delegates exact {candidatesFor} validation to one internal PolicyDecisionPoint and whose decideAll(requests) preflights a full ordinary dense array of exact genuine PolicyRequest values before any collaborator call, then evaluates one PDP decision per request in exact input order, stopping on the first failure with no partial result.

correctionWave1.why: MASTER independently confirmed 1/3 PASS at the original hash against this writer's then-current implementation: (1) an accessor own property at an array index (not an own data property) was silently invoked and its resolved value admitted into decideAll's evaluation instead of being refused before any getter ran, and (2) a collaborator-driven mutation of the caller-owned array at a later index, performed after preflight validation, replaced what decideAll evaluated at that index instead of the original validated request identity. The test writer's replan added, to the existing preflight scenario, an accessor-array-element assertion and an extra-own-property assertion, and added, to the existing sequencing scenario, a snapshot-integrity assertion. Both defects required a source-side fix in the allowed src/application/policy-batch-evaluator.mjs, not a further test correction.
correctionWave1.redAtWave1: 1/3 PASS against this writer's pre-fix implementation, independently confirmed by MASTER before this writer's second pass: the integration scenario remained GREEN; the preflight scenario failed at the new accessor-array-element assertion (the accessor's getter ran and its value was silently accepted); the sequencing scenario failed at the new snapshot-integrity assertion (the mid-batch mutation replaced the evaluated request at index 2).
correctionWave1.greenAtWave1: 3/3 PASS after this writer replaced the index-membership admission check in checkRequests with a descriptor-level check: exact Array.prototype, own-key parity (no key beyond the dense indices plus length), and, for every index, an own enumerable data property (never an accessor) whose descriptor value passes the exact genuine PolicyRequest brand check, all evaluated before any collaborator call; decideAll now builds and evaluates from a new internal snapshot array captured at preflight time, so a caller/collaborator mutation of the original array after preflight can no longer change what a later index evaluates. All other semantics (empty-array admission without a collaborator call, sequential one-call-per-request ordering, first-failure-stops-and-rejects with no partial result, deterministic non-mutating output) are unchanged.
